bias.title: BIAS
bias.does: Less bias: brighter, louder, dirtier. More: cleaner and darker.
bias.hood:
The record head adds an ultrasonic field to the signal. Each particle sees

H(t)=Hs(t)+Hbsin(2πfbt)

and is left on its anhysteretic curve as the field decays. The operating point sits at ; one pass of bias takes off an old recording.
bias.notModelled: The bias oscillator's own distortion and its leakage into the playback amplifier.

speed.title: TAPE SPEED
speed.does: Delay is head distance over speed. Changes glide with the motor's inertia.
speed.hood: Faster tape spreads each wavelength over more particles: less distortion at the top, less hiss. Measured on this build: third harmonic at +6 dB.

erase.title: ERASE
erase.does: In DUB: how much of the old take the erase head takes, once.
erase.hood: The erase field decays as the tape leaves the gap; what a cell keeps depends on how deep the old recording went. At 150 %: .

h2pos.title: HEAD 2 POSITION
h2pos.does: Distance from the record head: the further, the longer the echo.

part:capstan.title: CAPSTAN
part:capstan.does: Sets the tape speed. Its runout and bearings are the flutter.
part:capstan.hood: A freshly serviced machine measures weighted, a worn one .
part:capstan.notModelled: Capstan shaft bending under the pinch force.

part:play.title: PLAYBACK HEAD
part:play.does: Reads the magnetisation as it passes. Drag it along the rail.
part:play.hood: Gap and spacing losses shape the top end; at 15 kHz the record process costs .

part:tape.title: THE TAPE
part:tape.does: The strip is the magnetisation the engine holds right now.
part:tape.hood: Each cell is a Preisach medium in six layers.
